record.question: Choose the correct homophone to fill in the blank: The sun is __________.
record.explanation: Answer B: stationary. “Stationary” means not moving; “stationery” means writing materials. This is the paper’s homophone/spelling exercise, not a scientific assertion that the Sun has no motion in space. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
